title: Spicy Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional kebabs, inspired by Syrian cuisine. Perfect for a summer evening with a refreshing Thai twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, curry paste, onion, bell pepper, cilantro, soy sauce, honey, and lime juice. Toss to coat.
Thread lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve with your favorite Thai sides, such as steamed jasmine rice or spicy stir-fried vegetables.
Adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper to taste.
